$comment: EdgeSync DTDL language extension -- adds the 'ConfigConstraint' adjunct type so a DTDL Interface can declare, per Property and per Object Field: whether a JSON member is REQUIRED, whether it is WRITABLE, and its value bounds (numeric MINIMUM/MAXIMUM, string MINLENGTH/MAXLENGTH). DTDL v3 has no native 'required' / 'minimum' / 'maximum' / 'minLength' / 'maxLength' keywords at all, and its native 'writable' keyword is valid only on Property elements (never on Object fields); this extension fills all of those gaps for describing the devicecfg.json payload contract.
$importantNote: Stock Microsoft DTDL parsers (@azure/dtdl-parser, DTDLParser) cannot load a third-party extension -- there is no public registration API. A model that references this context parses as 'contextually incomplete': it still parses cleanly, every co-typed element is recorded as 'informally co-typed', and the 'required' / 'writable' members are preserved verbatim under the element's 'undefinedProperties'. ENFORCEMENT is therefore performed by the EdgeSync extension-aware validator (dtdl-validate/scripts/validate-devicecfg.js), which reads undefinedProperties.required / .writable -- not by the stock parser.

adjunctTypes.name: ConfigConstraint
adjunctTypes.description: Co-type applied to a Property (in an Interface's contents[]) or a Field (in an Object's fields[]). Declares the requiredness and writability of the corresponding JSON member.

properties.name: required
properties.description: true => the JSON member MUST be present on a valid devicecfg.json instance. false / absent => the member is OPTIONAL. Hard validation rule -- a missing required member fails validation.

properties.name: writable
properties.description: true => the member may be changed after creation (twin desired-property sync-able). false => the member is immutable after creation. Informational -- consumers (form UIs, twin-sync engines) use it to decide which inputs are editable; it does not by itself fail payload validation. On Property elements the native DTDL 'writable' keyword is used instead; this member carries writability for Object Fields, which DTDL cannot annotate natively.

properties.name: minimum
properties.description: Inclusive lower bound for a numeric member value (schema integer / long / double / float). value >= minimum. Absent => no lower bound. Hard validation rule.

properties.name: maximum
properties.description: Inclusive upper bound for a numeric member value (schema integer / long / double / float). value <= maximum. Absent => no upper bound. Hard validation rule.

properties.name: minLength
properties.description: Inclusive lower bound for a string member's character length. value.length >= minLength. Absent => no lower bound. Hard validation rule.

properties.name: maxLength
properties.description: Inclusive upper bound for a string member's character length. value.length <= maxLength. Absent => no upper bound. Hard validation rule.

properties.name: csvStringAccepted
properties.description: Array-typed field only. When true, a comma-separated string is accepted in place of the JSON array (the agent normalises it at parse time), and an empty string is treated as an empty array. When false / absent, only a JSON array is accepted.

properties.name: mutexGroup
properties.description: Mutual-exclusivity group. Fields of the same Object that share a mutexGroup value are mutually exclusive: at most one of them may be present with a non-empty value (non-empty string, non-empty array, or any non-string/array value). Hard validation rule. Used for Interface/Interfaces, PinId/PinIds, Source/Sources.

properties.name: allowedOnlyWhen
properties.description: Conditional presence. An object { "field": <sibling field name>, "equals": <string value> }. The annotated field may be present on the JSON instance only when the named sibling field of the same Object equals the given value; present otherwise is a hard validation error. Used so PinId/PinIds appear only when MetricName='pinState' and Source/Sources only when MetricName='therm'.

onProperty.@comment: On a Property: co-type for ConfigConstraint to carry 'required'; use the NATIVE DTDL 'writable' keyword for writability.

onField.@comment: On an Object Field: co-type for ConfigConstraint to carry 'required', 'writable', and any value bounds (DTDL has no native 'writable' / bound keywords for fields).

onStringField.@comment: String length bounds on a Field.

onCrossFieldRules.@comment: Mutual exclusion, conditional presence, and CSV-string tolerance on sibling Fields of one Object.
